text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day, and the academy is
humming
with anticipation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While other students typically hesitate
to
approach members of the student
council, more
than a few seem to have
been emboldened by the
occasion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Their gifts are piled high by the wall of
the
student council office.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now there's a familiar sight. Already that
time of
year again, is it?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Is all that Valentine's Day chocolate?

text_block_list.text:
Technically speaking, not all of it is
chocolate.
There are other kinds of
confections, too, and
some assorted
knickknacks...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But in the sense you mean, yes. They are
all gifts
for the student council.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We are well known. The higher our
profile among
the students, the larger
our pool of potential
admirers.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I expect their admiration is more akin to
that for
celebrities than anything else.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Besides, at their age, the younger
students desire
someone to look up to.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And who could fit that role better than
the
Emperor?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You're impressively objective about it all.

text_block_list.text:
On the contrary, I am a young
Umamusume like
any other. I might try
to take a neutral view, but I
cannot help
but be flattered.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I should add, all of these gifts were left
in front of
the student council office
rather than placed in
our hands directly.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Those who left them might have been
too
intimidated to address us directly,
but that only
makes their courage all the
more admirable.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
They are pure and earnest to the core.
One
cannot help but feel affection.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You're smiling from ear to ear.

text_block_list.text:
But of course. How could I not, when
speaking of
our precious students?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Now, I must see to sorting through these

chocolates.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This may take some time. You might
want to
come back later...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: I can give you a hand.

text_block_list.text: No, I couldn't possibly...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...Well, you are my confidant. I suppose no one would mind.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Very well—your aid is much appreciated.
Shall we
begin?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
First, we'll arrange the store-bought
goods by
sell-by date. These boxes
should come in useful...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Well, I think that just about does it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. With your help, it took
almost no time
at all.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Let's take a break, shall we? Would you
open that
drawer over there?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I open the drawer to find a rectangular
box
nestled within. It appears to contain
a bar of
chocolate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A token of my appreciation. I believe it
should go
well with coffee.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Not to boast, but I have seen more
Valentine's
Day gifts than anyone else in
the academy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I have become familiar with enough
brands of
chocolate to choose one that
best suits your
tastes.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Why not try it now? I can vouch for its
quality.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I take a bite and the rich flavor of cocoa
fills my
mouth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Still, this does pose a quandary.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You've done so much to help me today,
but I
have nothing to offer you in return.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Like the telephone said to the angry
ruler... this
calls for drastic measures.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: (I've got a bad feeling about this.)

text_block_list.text:
I am left with no choice but to confess
my
deepest secret.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You might find this difficult to believe,
but... I can
do magic.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You might think I've gone mad, but it's
the truth.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Royal blood can grant magical powers.
I'm sure
you've heard the stories.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What if I said my family was one such
line?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф's eyes are too intense for
this to
be a joke.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Let me prove my powers to you now.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Close your eyes and hold out your hand.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Yes, good. Just like that. Now...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Plop.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You may open your eyes.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A present adorned with a golden ribbon
sits in my
palm.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This chocolate is my gift to you. I hope
you find it
to your liking.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Perhaps that was a little too
theatrical.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'm used to receiving chocolate, but far
less
accustomed to giving it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I fear I got a little carried away...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: So you were lying about the magic?

text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I cast a spell on the
chocolate.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A spell of good cheer for you to enjoy as
you
take a bite.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, when I take a bite, I can't
help
breaking into a smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Only later, when I try to track down the
brand
myself, do I learn just how
expensive it is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
